entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, get me a person.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is VF7781-B.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me pull up that order. One moment.
Just tell me yes or no. Can I return it?
I see the order is for the Spin Class Shoes. To make sure I handle this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They don't fit. These cycling shoes are giving me blisters after every class. I don't even care about adjusting the cleats, the fit is just completely wrong. I want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear that they're causing blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for you. I see here you received them 38 days ago.
So? Can I return them or not?
Yes, you can. Our policy for standard items like these shoes allows for returns within 90 days. You're well within that window, so I can go ahead and approve this return for you right now.
Okay, good. What's next? Email me a label.

Exactly. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
